हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Revenge of a Best friend is a gripping cyber-thriller about a respected senior citizen who becomes the victim of a chilling digital scam involving deepfake videos, blackmail, and psychological imprisonment. As his life collapses in silence, his grandson uncovers a dark web of betrayal, exposing how technology can be used to destroy dignity, trust, and lives from within.
